name: SkySpaceAgency
author: JLSkyzer (based on K2-D2 by IanMealworm and Christophe Floutier)
description: SkySpaceAgency is an autopilot suite for KSP2 Redux: maneuver node execution, ascent guidance, automated landing, docking, and attitude hold, all from one panel (Alt-O or AppBar). Based on K2-D2 by Christophe Floutier and its Redux port by IanMealworm.
